candidates.sentence: He opposes amnesty and DACA, believes illegal aliens who commit crimes must be deported, and will work to stop sanctuary cities in Tennessee and across the country.
He will always stand up for the rule of law and support our border patrol agents.

While we can never fully repay their debt of service, Bill knows we must do everything we can to serve those who have sacrificed so much, and he will protect Fort Campbell, Arnold Air Force Base, and Millington Naval Base.
Bill believes that the Second Amendment is one of our most important freedoms, and he will always protect our constitutional rights, including our right to bear arms and protect ourselves.
Bill vehemently opposes taxpayer funds for abortion and abortion providers; he is fighting to defund Planned Parenthood.
He is working closely with his Republican colleagues in the Senate to cut frivolous spending, cut the corporate tax rate to encourage job growth, and make tax cuts permanent.

Bill will fight to ensure Washington is more careful with how it spends your federal tax dollars, encourage public-private partnerships, and work closely with President Trump to advocate for Tennessee’s highways and waterways.
Putting an end to illegal immigration begins with securing our southern border.
Bill supports moving towards a merit-based immigration system and common-sense solutions like requiring illegal aliens traveling with children to take a DNA test to prove their familial relationship.
He supports President Trump’s Remain in Mexico policy that helped stop the flow of illegal immigrants into America.

In the Senate, he is working to get government out of the way, cut unnecessary bureaucratic regulation, continue President Trump’s winning streak on low taxes, promote free trade, remove barriers to trade, strengthen the regulatory review process, and encourage companies to do business in Tennessee.
Bill opposes a national gun registry, red flag laws, and universal background checks.

Bill believes we need to continue to make the tax code simple, fair, low, and permanent, and he’s fighting to make sure our tax policy encourages job creation and makes our economy globally competitive.
He supports a balanced budget amendment to the Constitution.
Bill is fighting to pass a balanced budget amendment to the Constitution, and he supports no budget, no pay legislation.
He’s fighting for a balanced budget amendment to the Constitution.
